$comment: Schemas for the artefacts under bench/. Cited by the M7.16 gate report so a
reviewer can check a number against the field that produced it.
The single rule these schemas exist to enforce: every memory figure is an
ABSOLUTE LEVEL. No field in any of these documents is a difference between
two samples. ADR 0008 section 1 records RSS falling 4.4 MiB across 500
requests because JSC returned pages to its allocator, and this harness has
since reproduced a fall from 65.0 MiB to 29.0 MiB inside one idle bridge
process. A delta would report that as a 55% improvement.
Sample counts: a compliant memory capture has sampling.shortSample = false,
shortSample = true must not be cited in a gate report.

aibridge.bench.mem/1.description: bench/mem.sh and bench/three-process.sh output. Absolute RSS levels in MiB.

units.description: rssSource is ps -o rss=, which reports KiB on macOS and Linux alike.

ticksObserved.description: Ticks actually performed. A value below requestedSamples means the run was truncated and mem.sh refuses to emit a summary.

shortSample.description: true when the run fell below 1 Hz or 60 s and --allow-short was passed. MUST NOT be cited in a gate report.

processes.description: Keyed by slot name, which is the first alternative of its matcher expression.

matcher.description: '|'-separated alternatives. Matched against the process comm name first; argv substring only if no alternative matched a comm exactly.

sum.description: THE PRIMARY NUMBER. Per-tick sum over the slots that were alive in at least one tick, summed at a single instant.

completeTicks.description: Ticks where every slot in slotsIncluded was present. Ticks with an absent slot are excluded from the sum entirely rather than counted as zero.

series.description: Raw per-tick MiB levels, keyed by slot name plus a "sum" entry. Observed samples only: absent ticks contribute no value and are counted in absentTicks. This is the shape bench_compare reads to classify a run against a baseline.

verdict.description: A verdict of improve or regress requires non-overlapping p5..p95 bands AND a median move beyond the 5% noise floor. Overlapping bands are always noise.

headlineWarning.description: Emitted by bench/three-process.sh. States that router-only figures are not a host-level result. A report quoting the router's figure must carry this warning with it.

median.description: For even n, the mean of the two central order statistics.

p5.description: Nearest rank: value at 1-based index ceil(0.05 * n). No interpolation.

p95.description: Nearest rank: value at 1-based index ceil(0.95 * n). No interpolation.

p99.description: Nearest rank: value at 1-based index ceil(0.99 * n). No interpolation.

distribution.percentileMethod: nearest rank, no interpolation: a percentile is always an observed value, so a reported gate number cannot be a level the system never held

aibridge.bench.latency/1.description: bench/latency.sh output. Wall-clock round trip per request in milliseconds.

concurrency.description: Requests are issued sequentially; this measures service time, not concurrency behaviour.

warmup.description: Excluded from latencyMs. Lazy JIT allocation means a sample taken right after start under-reports.

failedRequests.description: Non-2xx/3xx responses. Excluded rather than averaged in; a failed curl prints 0.000000 s and would otherwise be the best sample in the distribution.

aibridge.bench.imports/1.description: bench/imports-probe.sh output. The ADR 0008 section 1 import ladder, as levels. NOT a steady-state measurement and NOT the gate baseline.

error.description: Present when the step's probe threw. levelMib is then null; it is never 0, which would read as 'this module costs nothing'.

aibridge.bench.baseline/1.description: bench/baseline/engines.json. The committed ADR 0008 section 1 capture.

partial.description: true when any ADR row or section 5.2 target could not be reproduced on this host. An artefact with partial = false claims full coverage.

missing.description: Names each unreproducible row and why. Required to be non-empty whenever partial is true.
